text:
You're not broke because you have no money.

You're broke because you have no idea you'd actually act on.

Every fortune ever built started the same way: as a thought in one man's head. No cash. No connections. Just an idea.

And here's the part nobody told you — a clear idea plus the guts to move on it is already HALF the job done.

Money doesn't start wealth. Ideas do. Money just follows the man who's ready.

Half of rich happens before you spend a single dime.
caption:
Every fortune in history started with zero dollars — just one idea a man refused to drop.
